description: The article operationalizes a four-code taxonomy of image roles in math problems: REQUIRED, USEFUL, NOTREQUIRED, and INSUFFICIENT.
title: Dependence-based image-role taxonomy for visual math items

description: The paper presents imagination, following Egan (1992), as a cognitive tool representing Constructivist instruction as higher-order learning.
title: Imagination as a neglected cognitive tool essential to Constructivist instruction (Egan)

title: Impactful technology use framework: six categories of student skills technology should develop

description: The organizing framework of the tool distinguishes implicit and explicit dimensions of place-based systems change that funders must consider together.
title: Implicit and explicit dimensions of place-based systems change as complementary axes for funder assessment

description: The implicit scaffolding framework holds that scaffolding need not be written or verbal but can be built into the design of a learning tool, so that students find productive inquiry paths without explicit instructions.
title: Implicit scaffolding framework: guidance built into the tool via affordances, constraints, cueing and feedback
